newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Avesta Sheffield to combine U.S. units.
newsitem.headline: Avesta Sheffield to combine U.S. units.

text.p: British-Swedish steelmaker Avesta Sheffield AB said on Friday it would consolidate its U.S. plate mill production from January next year.
"The production of plate in Baltimore, Maryland will be transferred to New Castle, Indiana," Avesta Sheffield said in a statement.
It said the move would improve customer service through a less complex production and delivery stucture.

"The expense of operating two plate mill production lines made it difficult to provide a cost competitive product in today's marketplace," said Mike Rinker, president of the company's North American division, in the statement.
It said the move was part of a wider programme to reduce operating costs and enhance competitiveness.
Avesta Sheffield is owned 51 percent by British Steel Plc.
